title: 3I/ATLAS, an interstellar comet
intro: SPHEREx images of the interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS. Every frame is a single exposure cut around the position the comet had at that moment, so the stars move from frame to frame while the comet stays at the center.
unavailable: The 3I/ATLAS sequence is not available on this server yet.
follows: These frames follow the comet. Each one is centered on the JPL Horizons position at its own time.
stackNote: Stack aligned on the comet: the comet stays sharp and the stars trail across the field.
noExposures: No single exposures for this detector in this campaign.
noStack: No stack for this detector in this campaign.

player.aria: Single exposures of the comet, one detector, ordered by time. Use the left and right arrow keys to step, Home and End to jump.
player.stretch: One intensity stretch is shared by all exposures of this detector.
player.reticle: Position of the comet from JPL Horizons at the time of this frame

spectrum.title: Spectrum of the comet
spectrum.plotAria: Flux of the comet in the aperture against wavelength, one point per exposure
spectrum.counts: {{total}} exposures measured in this campaign, {{flagged}} flagged. Flagged points are drawn apart and are not used in the band test.
spectrum.aperture: Forced photometry at the Horizons position: aperture radius {{ap}} arcsec, background annulus {{in}} to {{out}} arcsec. No aperture correction is applied, so the flux is not a total flux of the coma.
spectrum.none: No spectrum is stored for this campaign.
spectrum.notMeasurable: Not measurable in this campaign: {{n}} usable points in the band window, and at least {{min}} are needed in each window. No detection is claimed.
spectrum.belowSnr: Not measurable in this campaign: the {{nBlue}}, {{nBand}} and {{nRed}} points in the blue, band and red windows meet the 2 required, but at least one window mean is detected below 3 sigma (S/N {{snrBlue}}, {{snrBand}} and {{snrRed}}). No detection is claimed.
spectrum.measuredDifference: Band flux {{band}} mJy against a continuum that is not detected (3 sigma upper limit {{upper}} mJy): band minus continuum {{sig}} sigma. No ratio is reported.
spectrum.measuredExcess: Measured excess over the interpolated continuum: {{excess}} ± {{err}} ({{sig}} sigma).
spectrum.ephemeris: The centroid of the coma lies within its position bound of the Horizons position in {{within}} of {{measured}} measured exposures. Median offset {{median}} arcsec, largest {{max}} arcsec.
spectrum.positions: Positions come from JPL Horizons (solution {{solution}}), computed for the geocenter with a topocentric correction for each frame from the spacecraft position.
spectrum.parallax: The spacecraft is in low Earth orbit; the parallax shift between the geocentric and the spacecraft view is at most {{value}} arcsec in this campaign.

result.headline: 3I/ATLAS, an interstellar comet
result.look: Step through the exposures: the comet stays at the center while the stars move. Then read the spectrum below.
result.check: Position check (V-14): {{within}} of {{measured}} measured exposures within their bound of the Horizons position, median offset {{median}} arcsec.
result.co2: CO2 band: not measurable in this campaign. SPHEREx observed this band in too few exposures for the test, so no detection of CO2 is claimed.
result.co2Difference: CO2 band: {{band}} mJy, {{sig}} sigma above a continuum that is not detected (3 sigma upper limit {{upper}} mJy); validation V-13 {{status}}.
result.co2Measured: CO2 band: excess {{excess}} ± {{err}} ({{sig}} sigma) over the continuum; validation V-13 {{status}}.
result.limit: A coma is extended and the aperture sum is not a total flux. The position of its centroid is a photocenter, not the nucleus.
